properties.name: Paradise Launch Site
properties.description: Put-in. Permit check station. Water, toilets.

properties.name: Double Drop
properties.description: Two-tiered drop visible from river left. Scout mandatory at high water. Line left through both drops.

properties.name: Little Niagara
properties.description: Clean line river right. Watch for pour-over at center at high flows.

properties.name: Wolf Creek Camp
properties.description: Large sandy beach, river left. Good first-night camp. Spring water upslope.

properties.name: Galloping Gertie
properties.description: Long wave train, straightforward at most levels. Stay center.

properties.name: Glover Creek Camp
properties.description: Established camp river right at Glover Creek confluence. Good shade.

properties.name: Ladle
properties.description: Technical rapid with multiple channels. Scout river left. Best line varies by level.

properties.name: Moose Creek Airstrip Camp
properties.description: Largest camp on the river. Backcountry airstrip nearby. Good swimming hole below camp.

properties.name: Moose Creek Rapid
properties.description: At the mouth of Moose Creek. Read and run right of center. Opens up at high water.

properties.name: Moose Juice
properties.description: Most notorious rapid on the Selway. Mandatory scout river left. Complex hole at center. Most parties portage left at high water.

properties.name: Three Links Camp
properties.description: Named for Three Links Creek. Rocky beach, river right. Good mid-trip layover spot.

properties.name: Ham Rapid
properties.description: Rollicking wave train. Fun run center to left.

properties.name: Cupboard Creek Camp
properties.description: River left, large flat site. Named for Cupboard Creek. Popular 3rd-night camp.

properties.name: Tee Kettle
properties.description: Powerful hole in center. Run far right. Scout from river left.

properties.name: Goat Bar Camp
properties.description: One of the nicest camps on the lower Selway. Gravel bar, open views.

properties.name: Gedney Rapid
properties.description: River bends left into a constriction. Technical at low water, pushy at high.

properties.name: Selway Falls
properties.description: Unrunnable 15-ft waterfall. Mandatory portage river left — 0.5 mi trail. Do not miss the take-out above the falls.

properties.name: O'Hara Bar Camp
properties.description: Last camp before Race Creek take-out. Good water and flat sites.

properties.name: Race Creek Takeout
properties.description: Take-out. Road access. Parking and shuttle drop area.
